name: Heinfels
kurzbeschreibung: Charming market town in the Pustertal with the eponymous Burg Heinfels – the iconic landmark of Tiroler Pustertal.
beschreibung:
Heinfels lies in the Tiroler Pustertal at 1,030 meters above sea level, a few kilometers west of Sillian in the district of Lienz. The market town has around 1,000 inhabitants and looks back on a long history as an administrative seat in the upper Pustertal.

Burg Heinfels towers above the town, one of the largest and best-preserved castle complexes in Osttirol. The fortification from the 13th century was expanded several times over time and rises prominently on a rocky spur high above the valley. After extensive restoration, the complex is now open to visitors and serves as a venue for concerts and knight tournaments. Around Heinfels, numerous hiking trails begin that appeal to both families with children and experienced mountain hikers – for example tours toward Burgberg, to the Thurntaler, or into the Villgratental. The proximity to the Austrian-Italian border and to the Dolomiten also makes the town an ideal starting point for excursions in both directions.

Culturally, Heinfels maintains a mix of old castle tradition and lively village life. Regular festivals, including the Burgfest, attract visitors from all over the Pustertal. In the dining scene, classic Osttiroler inns with regional cuisine dominate – from Kasnocken to local game from the Villgrater mountains. Anyone who wants to experience Osttirol away from the well-known hotspots will find in Heinfels a quiet, historic location with genuine Tiroler character.
